A Runway with Real Impact

Good to Know

Frequently Asked Questions

What is The Fashion PAWty?

The Fashion PAWty is a doggie fashion show and community celebration — "A Navigation Celebration" — hosted by the Eye Spy Foundation in Jacksonville, Florida. Dogs strut the orange carpet while the community enjoys mocktails, food, games, and music, all to support the blind and low vision community and Leader Dogs for the Blind.

When and where is The Fashion PAWty?

Saturday, September 26, 2026, from 4 to 7 PM at Happy Brew, 3200 Hendricks Ave, Jacksonville, FL 32207.

How much are tickets and what is included?

Tickets are $30 and include entry to the show, food, and mocktails.

Who does the event benefit?

The Eye Spy Foundation and Leader Dogs for the Blind. Eye Spy is also sponsoring one Leader Dogs puppy this year.

More questions? Visit the full FAQ page or email team@eyespy.org.

Who the PAWty Helps

Every Wagging Tail Supports Two Missions

Eye Spy Foundation

We help the blind and low vision community navigate community resources so they can live a better low vision lifestyle — greeting everyone with a hug or a handshake.

Meet Eye Spy Foundation

Leader Dogs for the Blind

A guide dog school raising and training dogs to help people travel safely and independently. This year Eye Spy is sponsoring one Leader Dogs puppy.
